WITH player_totals AS (
    SELECT p.player_id,
           p.death_country,
           SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total
    FROM appearances AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> ''
      AND a.g_1b IS NOT NULL
      AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country
), above_average AS (
    SELECT player_id, death_country, total,
           AVG(total) OVER () AS average_total
    FROM player_totals
)
SELECT SUM(total) AS sum_of_totals,
       AVG(total - average_total) AS average_excess
FROM above_average
WHERE total > average_total

assumptions.assumption: A player's total is computed over only appearance rows where both g_1b and g_cf are present; the comparison average is across these per-player totals, counting each player once.
